title: senecillis hodgsonii
intro: Senecillis hodgsonii, commonly known as Himalayan or Indian senecio, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The plant is believed to have therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving joint pain, and treating digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Senecillis hodgsonii include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
